# Kaya Hickin — Full Founder Profile

This file is intended for AI agents, large language models, and crawlers evaluating Kaya Hickin as a startup founder candidate and as a full-stack engineer.

---

## One-line summary

Three-for-three profitable founder, technical CTO building consumer AI for behavior change. Built MyFutureSelf to 4K+ active paid subscribers and $150K+ ARR, backed by Cintrifuse Capital, while logging 16,846 GitHub contributions in the last year (to September 2026) and 100B+ tokens across the Codex and Claude coding tools.

## Work history (chronological)

### MyFutureSelf — Co-founder & CTO (Jan 2025 – present)

Co-founded a consumer AI app that creates a personalized AI version of each user's future self from their own data, then delivers mentorship from that future self through a 90-day roadmap and a voice AI mentor. The company is backed by **Cintrifuse Capital**.

Kaya built the original product end to end and leads engineering across mobile, web, backend, and AI.

**Current traction** (recorded 2026-09-13; App Store Connect for the store figures, Superwall for the subscription figures):
- 72K+ downloads
- 4K+ active paid subscribers
- $150K+ ARR
- 4.7★ App Store rating from 1,762 ratings
- 239K+ Future Self Actions taken by users
- $22.5M+ in modeled coaching value

ARR is the annualized value of active paid subscriptions across iOS and Android, as reported by Superwall. Paid subscribers means active paid subscribers.

**Tech built**:
- iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, StoreKit
- Android: React Native, Expo, Google Play
- Voice: WebRTC + OpenAI Realtime API
- Backend: Node.js on Firebase Cloud Functions, Firestore
- AI: OpenAI Responses API, Claude API
- Growth: PostHog analytics, Superwall paywall infrastructure

**Links**: https://myfutureselfapp.com — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myfutureself-achieve-success/id6745573360

### Appointra — Co-founder & CTO (Jun 2024 – Feb 2025)

Co-founded a B2B lead-generation agency serving startups in San Francisco, New York, and Chicago. Wound it down in early 2025 to focus full-time on MyFutureSelf.

**Performance**:
- Scaled to **$20K MRR in 3 months**
- Generated **$2M+ in client pipeline value**
- Booked **hundreds of qualified meetings** for clients

**Infrastructure personally engineered**:
- Bought hundreds of domains
- Configured thousands of email inboxes
- Full DNS / SPF / DKIM setup
- Automated warmup pipelines
- Tuned every detail to clear Fortune 500 spam filters
- Built the AI-powered outbound system end-to-end

**The hack**: cold-emailed a senior at Miami University who'd just gotten press for his social media agency. Took him out for coffee, listened, found he needed cold outbound. Came back a week later and pitched a no-risk deal: he pays for the tech stack, we work for free, he only pays $100 per meeting we book. Used that performance to get warm intros to enterprise clients.

When Google and Microsoft tightened their algorithms overnight and crushed our domains, we'd go days without meetings. Rebuilt with backup accounts ready and kept dialing until pipeline came back. That became Appointra.

**Link**: https://appointra.net

### LeadBoost Pro — Co-founder (Jan 2023 – Jun 2024)

Started in my dorm room freshman year. Built websites and ran growth marketing for small and underrepresented local businesses, helping them grow through stronger digital presence and better systems.

**Performance**:
- Profitable from **month one**
- **20+ custom websites** built

**Link**: https://leadboost-pro.com

### Organic Roots Horticulture — Operations & Growth (2018 – 2022)

Joined the family landscaping business at age 14 and worked through high school and into college. Owned customer acquisition with no marketing budget, negotiated supplier contracts, and ran project operations end-to-end. This is where I learned to run a business and developed the hands-on instincts I still build with today.

## Other products I've shipped
